means: Games cold-clear played ALONE (self-play, no garbage, no opponent) in which the corpus classifier (technique-facts.ts classify, the profile analysis/cutcopy-facts.json is built with) finds a 千鳥格子 window: the bot's own placements up to the last lock deciding a hit's follow-up and a few more, replayed through the vendored Triangle engine, which is the arbiter, and recorded as a timeline a page can play.
not_eligible_because: played by a bot, not by either player, and not any source's drawing: no claim id, no badge, no figure in any count of the corpus.
caveat: one search sample per game (cold-clear's search is seeded by COACH_SEED), an unconverged node budget, no garbage: these games say nothing about how often a person, or the bot under pressure, builds one.
rules: every placement is cold-clear's; the path to it is the engine's (reach + inputsOf, SRS+, 180 allowed), and for a T the first path whose engine spin equals cold-clear's
the engine is the arbiter: each lock must land on cold-clear's cells with cold-clear's line count, or the game is cut
the hits are the corpus classifier's, run unchanged on the replayed games, and must equal the scan's
the committed placements stop 2 locks after the last lock that decides a hit's follow-up
